changes: Reuse finite test-helper graphs, guarded local checks, exact actual/formal source transformations, and recursive SCC edges.
Restore known framework assertion adapters through generic local source-flow extraction, including TypeScript throwing and negated matchers.
Render check predicates, guards and actual arguments directly as source text, with references and complete source retained.
Use a short explicit decision basis followed by bounded P/Q judgments, with internal thinking disabled.
P explicitly covers setup and complete-test semantics not represented by local Q checks. Partial source extraction is reported separately from model support.

admission_rule.schema: Exactly basis:string and judgments:{each requested P/Q id: supported|unsupported|unknown}
admission_rule.unsupported: Any unsupported judgment rejects the model hypothesis.
admission_rule.all_supported: Admit as a model hypothesis requiring independent complete-program evaluation; not a proof or source-completeness certificate.
admission_rule.basis_word_limit: 120 words is prompt guidance, not a hidden validity filter.
admission_rule.source_partial: All unresolved source boundaries remain visible; essential missing semantics must yield unknown. Do not equate generic external-call opacity with a proved invalid test.

interpretation: Representation, prompt and admission aggregation differ from guarded v5. This is a new formulation, not an isolated compression ablation.

verification.scope: compact analyzer/admission, runner, independent receipt auditor
